package org.eclipse.rdf4j.sail.lmdb;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import org.eclipse.rdf4j.model.Literal;
import org.eclipse.rdf4j.model.base.CoreDatatype;
import org.eclipse.rdf4j.model.impl.SimpleValueFactory;
import org.eclipse.rdf4j.repository.sail.SailRepository;
import org.eclipse.rdf4j.sail.lmdb.config.LmdbStoreConfig;

/** A separate-process public API oracle, also compiled against the frozen unpatched maintenance binary. */
public final class LmdbMaintenanceInteropProcess {
	public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
		String phase = args[0];
		Path directory = Path.of(args[1]);
		boolean inline = Boolean.parseBoolean(args[2]);
		var config = new LmdbStoreConfig(phase.equals("create-legacy") ? "spoc,posc" : "spoc,posc,ospc")
				.setInlineLiterals(inline).setSketchEstimatorEnabled(false).setForceSync(true);
		SailRepository repository = new SailRepository(new LmdbStore(directory.toFile(), config));
		if (phase.equals("reject-v6")) {
			try { repository.init(); } catch (RuntimeException expected) { return; }
			throw new AssertionError("Unpatched maintenance writer accepted v6");
		}
		repository.init();
		try (var connection = repository.getConnection()) {
			var vf = SimpleValueFactory.getInstance();
			var predicate = vf.createIRI("urn:v2:predicate");
			var datatype = vf.createIRI("urn:v2:shared-custom-datatype");
			var literal = vf.createLiteral("shared custom value", datatype);
			var inner = vf.createTripleTerm(vf.createBNode("shared-v2-bnode"), predicate, literal);
			var outer = vf.createTripleTerm(vf.createIRI("urn:v2:outer"), predicate, inner);
			if (phase.startsWith("create")) {
				connection.begin();
				connection.setNamespace("v2", "urn:v2:");
				connection.add(vf.createIRI("urn:v2:first"), predicate, outer);
				connection.add(vf.createIRI("urn:v2:second"), predicate, inner, vf.createIRI("urn:v2:graph"));
				connection.add(vf.createBNode("shared-v2-bnode"), predicate, literal);
				connection.commit();
			}
			if (phase.equals("mutate")) {
				connection.begin();
				connection.add(vf.createIRI("urn:v2:legacy-writer"), predicate,
						vf.createLiteral("legacy writer value", datatype), vf.createIRI("urn:v2:graph"));
				List<Literal> literals = v2Literals();
				for (int i = 0; i < literals.size(); i++) {
					connection.add(vf.createIRI("urn:v2:legacy-lexical:" + i), predicate, literals.get(i));
				}
				connection.commit();
			}
			if (phase.equals("verify")) {
				List<Literal> literals = v2Literals();
				for (int i = 0; i < literals.size(); i++) {
					Literal expected = literals.get(i);
					var subject = vf.createIRI("urn:v2:lexical:" + i);
					if (!connection.hasStatement(subject, predicate, expected, false)) {
						throw new AssertionError("Unpatched binary could not look up exact lexical " + i);
					}
					try (var rows = connection.getStatements(subject, predicate, null, false)) {
						if (!rows.hasNext() || !expected.equals(rows.next().getObject()) || rows.hasNext()) {
							throw new AssertionError("Unpatched binary lost enumerated lexical " + i);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (!connection.hasStatement(vf.createIRI("urn:v2:first"), predicate, outer, false)) {
				throw new AssertionError("Maintenance binary lost nested terms");
			}
			if (phase.equals("verify") && !connection.hasStatement(vf.createIRI("urn:v2:maintenance"), predicate,
					vf.createLiteral("maintenance write"), false)) {
				throw new AssertionError("Unpatched binary did not read maintenance write");
			}
		} finally {
			repository.shutDown();
		}
		if (Files.exists(directory.resolve("lmdbrdf.ver"))) {
			throw new AssertionError("Maintenance v2 acquired a v6 marker");
		}
	}
	private static List<Literal> v2Literals() {
		var vf = SimpleValueFactory.getInstance();
		return List.of(vf.createLiteral("42", CoreDatatype.XSD.INT),
				vf.createLiteral("+0042", CoreDatatype.XSD.INT), vf.createLiteral("-42", CoreDatatype.XSD.INT),
				vf.createLiteral("42.00", CoreDatatype.XSD.DECIMAL),
				vf.createLiteral("2026-10-03T12:00:01Z", CoreDatatype.XSD.DATETIME),
				vf.createLiteral("2026-10-03T12:00:01.0Z", CoreDatatype.XSD.DATETIME),
				vf.createLiteral("2026-10-03T12:00:01.00Z", CoreDatatype.XSD.DATETIME),
				vf.createLiteral("2026-10-03T12:00:01.000Z", CoreDatatype.XSD.DATETIME),
				vf.createLiteral("2026-10-03T12:00:01.123", CoreDatatype.XSD.DATETIME),
				vf.createLiteral("2026-10-03T12:00:01+13:37", CoreDatatype.XSD.DATETIME),
				vf.createLiteral("2026-10-03T12:00:01.00Z", CoreDatatype.XSD.DATETIMESTAMP),
				vf.createLiteral("2026-10-03Z", CoreDatatype.XSD.DATE),
				vf.createLiteral("2026-10-03+13:37", CoreDatatype.XSD.DATE));
	}
}
